title: 3 BHK 310 sq.yd Bungalow for Sale · Shangrila Bungalow Part 1, Thaltej
address: Shangrila Bungalow Part 1, near Shell petrol pump, Zydus Hospital Road, Thaltej, Ahmedabad
description: Fully furnished bungalow in Shangrila Bungalow Part 1, on Zydus Hospital Road, Thaltej, near the Shell petrol pump, on a 310 sq.yd plot with over 300 sq.yd of construction.
Three bedrooms, three washrooms, a seva room, a lounge, a full sized terrace cabin and parking for two cars. Priced at ₹6.5 Cr.
